name: 60452 · Oak Forest, IL
findings: ZIP 60452 (Oak Forest) has 50 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60452 (Oak Forest) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 60452 (Oak Forest) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 67% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.
